description: Receive files that a person or another agent is sending through Files Direct, from the link or nine-digit code they gave you. Calling it is the yes: it lists what is offered, then takes it, straight to disk, checking every block and every file. It writes only inside the folders this server was started with, never replaces a file unless you say so, and refuses what is bigger than the size limit. The transfer goes on in the background: follow it with transfer_status.

folder.description: Where to save, inside an allowed folder. It is made if it is not there. Default: a folder called files-direct-received in the first allowed folder.

link_or_code.description: The link (it ends in /r/# and a long text) or the nine-digit code the sender gave you.

max_size_mb.description: Refuse an offer bigger than this many megabytes. Default 2048.

overwrite.description: Replace files that are already there. Default false: nothing is replaced, and an offer that would replace a file is refused.

password.description: The password, if the sender set one.

name: receive_files
title: Receive files
